text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That was too close for comfort. I was
nearly late
today! You see, something
froze my legs in their
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you know this. The morning
dew on
the grass near the river... If you
look closely at
the droplets, you can see
the whole world inside,
upside down.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing more boring to me than
going
straight to the academy. I'd miss
this whole
unknown universe beneath my
feet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But no worries, I made it in time! Hehe,
it pays to
be an Umamusume.
